name: io.github.ni-c/imap-mcp
title: IMAP mailbox
description: Read, search and organise any IMAP mailbox, with writes off by default

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Hostname of the IMAP server, e.g. imap.example.net

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_USER
environmentVariables.description: Mailbox user name

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Mailbox password or app password

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Defaults to 993 with implicit TLS, 143 otherwise

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_TLS
environmentVariables.description: implicit (default), starttls or none

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_MAILBOX
environmentVariables.description: Default mailbox to work in (default: INBOX)

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_SEEN_KEYWORD
environmentVariables.description: IMAP keyword marking what the assistant has already seen (default: AiSeen)

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to register the mailbox write tools; defaults to true

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_ALLOW_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to register; 'essential' selects a curated preset (default: all tools)

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_DENY_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to remove from whatever IMAP_ALLOW_TOOLS left

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_DOWNLOAD_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory attachments may be written to; unset means the server never touches the filesystem

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_INSECURE_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to accept self-signed certificates, scoped to this connection

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_DRAFTS_MAILBOX
environmentVariables.description: Drafts folder to save into; by default the one flagged \Drafts is used

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_MAX_MESSAGES
environmentVariables.description: Default number of messages a listing returns (default: 100)

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling for returning an attachment inline (default: 1048576)

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_MAX_DOWNLOAD_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling for writing an attachment to disk (default: 26214400)

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_ATTACHMENT_TYPES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated content-type allowlist for attachments
